---
title: "LLM ability to play games"
claim: "LLMs show limited ability to play single-player and multiplayer games."
---

**LLMs show limited ability to play single-player and multiplayer games.**

Frontier LLMs struggle playing games that are simple for children to solve.
![](images/image9.png){.column-margin}

- Paul Calcraft [discusses](https://x.com/paul_cal/status/1890824247792037898) the state of LLM-gameplaying in early 2025: their performance in tic-tac-toe, connect 4, codenames, and chess, is still well below that of human experts.

- @payne2025strategic find that LLMs are "highly competitive" with the most successful strategies in playing iterated prisoners dilemma games.
- LMGame-Bench (@hu2025lmgamebench) finds that as of early 2025, LLMs are still below human performance across 6 computergames: Sokoban, Super Mario Bros, Tetris, 2048, Candy Crush, and Ace Attorney.
- TextQuests (@phan2025textquests) find as of August 2025 LLMs are unable to solve text-based adventure games that would take human players around 30 hours and hundreds of actions to solve without assistance. With clues granted recent models are able to make greater progress- whilst no model prior to 2025 is able to solve any adventure completely, GPT-5 is able to solve 5/25.
